decisions.reason: The source changes visual editing style and prohibited visual treatments but does not change the existing hook-selection criterion.
The source separately establishes the one-video batch constraint, which is already represented by a same-message Event; the visual-style change adds no further source-selection change.
The prohibition on crazy effects and transitions applies to general visual editing and does not change the existing requirement to use color in captions and letters.
The source does not specify or change any caption-font requirement.
The source separately changes the substantive-moment standard, and that change is already represented by its same-message MODIFY Event.
The source separately refines narrative completeness, and that change is already represented by its same-message MODIFY Event.
The source reiterates the already-current assignment of eight trial clips and therefore does not change the candidate state.
The source provides no new minimum or maximum clip duration and leaves the 20–120 second rule unchanged.
The source reiterates the existing target of 180 approved clips per month without changing its value or counting basis.
